outcome: Mode of delivery (Caesarean section vs. vaginal delivery)
cohort: 23 pregnancies of 18 patients with PHT followed-up in the obstetrics and gynecology department of a tertiary care center.
finding: Pregnancies complicated by PHT, especially advanced PHT classes, were associated with a high risk of maternal and fetal complications, highlighting the need for a well-planned, multidisciplinary approach to care.
